# Writing Case

## Purpose

Synthesize approved evidence and Claims into one bounded requested research output.

## Preconditions

Use a writing-stage bounded Dispatch with source evidence and Claims and the target format and path supplied, one repository, and network forbidden.

## Inputs

Use approved evidence, Claims, context and artifacts, objective and audience, expected output, allowed paths, and checks.

## Procedure

Build an evidence-to-Claim outline, draft only supported statements, preserve citations and provenance, separate findings, limitations, uncertainty, and proposals, and write only the declared output.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result summarizing the written artifact and checks plus one pending Proposal registering the artifact or recommending root-reviewed follow-up.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on an unsupported Claim, missing citation, undisclosed conflicting evidence, undeclared output path, or a request to invent completion.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not create new evidence authority, promote Claims, mutate canonical Research, use network research, decide Proposals, commit Git history, launch work, or expand scope.
